_policy: Pre-registered after the tune-half selection reads of Ballroom and Harmonix and BEFORE any candidate is read on GiantSteps, batida, the negatives, the marks recordings or any holdout half. Amendments are appended, never edited.
issue: #4499 (board): the bar line (downbeat) flip-flops. 40 bar_phase jumps in a 268 s EDM station recording, 37 while the tempo is locked, a third undone within 10 s.

mechanism_evidence.instrument: FOSFORA_DOWNBEAT_SIDECAR (dev-only, audio/downbeat_sidecar.rs): one record per scored beat with the three accent cues the beat wrote into the ring (raw f32 bits), the grid index, the tempo-lock flag, the branch update_meter_phase took (warm / fb / hold / cand / sw), the top (meter, phase, contrast) and the lock after it. Binary fosfora-instr-q4499-acd626d6435480fa = main d9a6e42 (v2.7.1) plus the sidecar; with the sidecar ON its signal dumps are byte-identical to q4474_ship's on all 1720 Ballroom / Harmonix / GiantSteps tracks.
mechanism_evidence.replica: tools/dbrep.py (/mnt/t9/fosfora-work/q4499/tools): rebuilds the ring, scores it in float32 in the Rust evaluation order, replays the decision rule. 0 decision mismatches over 1959 tracks (Ballroom 685, Harmonix 374, GiantSteps 661, negatives 155, batida 80, 4 marks recordings), 426,325 beats; its downbeat times equal the wire's /downbeat on every track and its per-track downbeat F equals the bench's on all 1059 Ballroom + Harmonix tracks and score_fosfora.py's down_f on all 80 batida renders. The tracker feeds nothing back into the beat path, so a forecast of its outputs is exact, not an approximation.
mechanism_evidence.move_definition: a bar-line move = a fired downbeat whose alignment (meter, grid index mod meter) differs from the previous fired downbeat's (kind 'align'), or, alignment unchanged, whose grid-index distance disagrees with the elapsed time by > 0.4 beat (kind 'grid', the beat grid itself moved). Counted while bpm/locked; per minute of locked beat time (sum of inter-beat gaps, each capped at 2 s); 'reverted' = the pre-move alignment returns within 10 s.

classification_tune_shipped_rule.predicate_fb: update_meter_phase: best_score < CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (.08) -> meter = 4, phase = strongest_phase(scored, 4), candidate cleared. Runs on every such beat, no hysteresis.
classification_tune_shipped_rule.predicate_sw: a challenger (meter, phase) that tops the contrast ranking HYSTERESIS_BEATS (8) consecutive beats takes the lock.
classification_tune_shipped_rule.harmonix_tune: 4864 locked moves in 625.5 min = 7.78/min; fallback 3003 (62%), hysteresis switch 1465 (30%, of which meter 3/4 flips 455), grid 381 (8%); 1862 revert within 10 s
classification_tune_shipped_rule.ballroom_tune: 1131 in 111.2 min = 10.17/min; fallback 434 (38%), switch 354 (31%), grid 340 (30%); 229 revert
classification_tune_shipped_rule.marks_4_recordings: 770 in 80.0 min = 9.63/min; fallback 582 (76%), switch 136, grid 52; 352 revert
classification_tune_shipped_rule.edm_20261023_111937_td: v2.7.1 replay: 42 moves, 36 locked = fallback 23, switch 9 (3 meter), grid 4; 11 revert within 10 s. (The q_crosssong reference dump was made by a pre-v2.7.1 binary, beats 10 ms later; wire_moves.py reads 36 / 34 locked there and 41 / 35 on the v2.7.1 replay.)

baseline.binary: fosfora-instr-q4499-acd626d6435480fa (main d9a6e42 v2.7.1 + sidecar; dumps byte-identical to q4474_ship 2a18053e6b2e1c2e)

split.rule: sha256(track_id) parity, even -> tune, odd -> holdout, on ballroom, harmonix and giantsteps_tempo

candidates.A_fbh8: the low-confidence fallback no longer moves the bar line by itself: its choice (4/4 on the strongest phase) becomes a challenger like any other and must win HYSTERESIS_BEATS (8) consecutive beats. No new constant.
candidates.B_fbh8_mg10_mfb: A, plus a challenger (from either branch) accrues a beat only while its contrast exceeds the current lock's own contrast by 0.10; otherwise the streak resets. One new constant.
candidates.C_fbh8_mg10: A, plus the 0.10 margin on the confident branch only.

forecast_tune._method: exact replica (tools/forecast.py), tune halves; downbeat F delta vs the shipped rule, tracks lost / gained by > .1, locked moves per minute, reverted within 10 s

rejected_on_tune_forecast.longer_switch_hysteresis: h12 / h16 / h24 with the shipped fallback: harmonix -.0051 / -.0054 / -.0140, ballroom -.0074 / -.0103 / -.0115; with fbh8, h12 harmonix +.0101 (below A) ballroom -.0076. Slower correction of a wrong lock costs more than the noise it filters.
rejected_on_tune_forecast.fallback_hold: fbhold (low confidence keeps the lock once a confident one exists): harmonix +.0159 but ballroom -.0039; with h16 harmonix +.0340 / ballroom -.0175 (63 lost / 39 gained); with h24/h32 ballroom -.018 / -.023. Ballroom's 30 s clips need the fallback to be able to relocate.
rejected_on_tune_forecast.meter_hysteresis: a longer streak for a meter change (hm12 / hm16) adds harmonix +.004 / +.005 over A but costs the waltzes: Ballroom VienneseWaltz -.016 / -.049, Waltz -.019 / -.021.
rejected_on_tune_forecast.confidence_threshold: conf .04 / .06 / .12 with the shipped fallback: harmonix +.0083 / +.0003 / +.0033 with ballroom -.0030 / +.0013 / +.0063 and moves 4.77 / 6.17 / 10.17 per min; with fbh8, conf .04 / .06 / .12 read within .004 of A on both sets. Not the lever.
rejected_on_tune_forecast.fallback_free_until_lock: fbh8_free (reassign on the spot until a confident lock): ballroom -.0047, harmonix +.0114, both below A.
rejected_on_tune_forecast.larger_margins: fbh8 with margin .15 / .20 / .30: harmonix +.0364 / +.0273 / +.0202 (non-monotonic), ballroom -.0030 / -.0113 / -.0090 with lost growing (64/52, 75/51, 88/57). Past .12 the bar line holds wrong locks on the short clips.

targets.P1_moves: locked moves per minute: harmonix <= 0.6 x baseline, giantsteps_tempo <= 0.6 x baseline, ballroom <= 0.85 x baseline (its 30% grid class is out of this tracker's reach); edm_20261023_111937_td locked moves <= 0.6 x 36 = 21
targets.P2_flipflop: harmonix moves reverted within 10 s <= 0.4 x baseline
targets.G2_ballroom_downbeat: ballroom downbeat_f >= baseline - 0.005 (about one paired SE on 30 s clips)
targets.G3_flips: per labeled dataset: tracks lost by > .1 <= gained + 2 x sqrt(lost + gained) (2 sigma of a no-change binomial)
targets.G4_batida: mean down_f over the 80 renders >= baseline - 0.01, and the waltz template's mean >= baseline - 0.02
targets.G5_beats_identical: the /beat event list identical to baseline on every bench track (the tracker feeds nothing back): beat F, CMLt, acc1, acc2 identical
targets.G6_negatives: locked moves on the 155 beatless clips <= baseline
targets.G7_marks: total locked moves over the 4 marks recordings <= 0.6 x baseline
targets.G8_structure: harmonix (all): drop hit rate, false drops per min and boundary_events F identical; label-derived boundary_3_0s F within 0.01 (section dwell counts bars)
targets.G9_build: cargo test (default + analyze), clippy as CI runs it, fixture check; a unit test pins the fix and fails on the shipped rule
targets.holdout: read once on the chosen arm: G1, G2, G3 on the holdout halves, P1 on harmonix / giantsteps / ballroom holdout

selection_rule: among candidates passing P1, P2, G1-G4, G6, G7 on the tune / guard forecast, the lowest harmonix tune locked moves per minute; if two are within 10% of each other, the one with fewer new constants (A has none). The chosen rule is then built, its own sidecars must replay at 0 mismatches under the new rule, its tune numbers must equal the forecast, and the holdout is read once.
on_miss: a missed target is recorded here with its numbers; constants are not re-tuned on the holdout.

Selection: B_fbh8_mg10_mfb (harmonix tune 2.27 locked moves/min against C 2.59 (+14%, outside the 10% tie band) and A 4.03). Implemented in downbeat.rs as SWITCH_MARGIN = 0.10 with the fallback's choice as an ordinary challenger; bench/replay_downbeat.py replays it ('current') and agrees with the forecast rule on every one of 426,325 baseline beats.

unregistered_observation_predict_drop.what: /predict/drop reads the bar clock (bar-in-progress withdrawal, phrase proximity, bar-denominated persistence). Not a pre-registered guard; q4163_report's harmonix_all aggregate (both halves, by its design) showed it in the tune verdict, and the per-half breakdown was printed while investigating, before the holdout verdict read.
unregistered_observation_predict_drop.harmonix_proxy_drops: 0.8 tier covered 53 -> 43 of 141 (12 lost on 10 tracks, 2 gained; tune 30 -> 26, holdout 23 -> 17); 0.8 crossings 1547 -> 1459; 0.5 tier 72 -> 73; false alarms 3455 -> 3450. These are proxy_chorus_onset drops (a chorus onset is not a drop).
unregistered_observation_predict_drop.local_hand_labeled: bench/labels (the drop workstream's ground truth, 34 drops on 14 tracks): 0.8 tier 19 -> 23 (4 gained, 0 lost), 0.5 tier 32 -> 32, false alarms 173 -> 176; /drop unchanged (11 matched, 27 false).
unregistered_observation_predict_drop.mechanism: not pinned. The lost proxy drops sat on the 0.8 edge (old peaks .80-.88, new mostly .78-.80); inside committed episodes the old bar line ran 1.7% fast (3.829 vs 3.894 beats per bar), too little to explain it alone; 7 of the 12 lost old crossings followed an old bar-line move within 4 s against a ~40% base rate.
unregistered_observation_predict_drop.decision: not a reason to hold the fix: the headline set improves, the proxy set falls, the 0.5 tier and false alarms are flat. Stated in the CHANGELOG entry. The predictor's constants were calibrated on the flip-flopping bar clock; re-freezing them on the stable one is a follow-up round.
